name: records_a_signature_covers_the_fields_in_the_order_the_spec_states
description: The signature covers record_id, record_type, hlc, author and body, in that order. Nothing else in the suite pins that, and getting it wrong is invisible from inside one implementation: it signs and verifies its own records perfectly and rejects every other implementation's, which reads as a network fault and is not. The signatures here were produced over exactly those bytes, so a different order fails this vector and nothing else.
